scope: Six selected distinct public business mechanisms, not exhaustive market research or a competitor league table.

models.selected_offer: HR.com Custom Research and the separate Future of Payroll 2025 sponsored output
models.comparability: Adjacent HR research offer with a payroll output; not evidence of a UK senior-payroll council.
models.buyer_or_funder: An organisation commissioning custom research; sponsor recognition is visible in the payroll example, but cash terms are unknown.
models.commercial_unit_and_currentness: Custom survey and branded report. Current package details remain unconfirmed: the accessible help article dates to 2021 and the linked main offer was blocked.
models.participant_or_member_value: Public research is free with account sign-in; commercial commissioning is a separate exchange.
models.jga_design_lesson: Specify the decision question, audience, outputs and funding. Sponsor recognition does not confer editorial control, raw answers or participant contacts.
models.critical_transfer_limit: No published fee or verified sales, margin or renewal economics.

public_price.status: Not published in reviewed accessible material; no quote requested.

models.evidence_basis: Publisher offer/terms and specific published-output context; researcher lessons are conditional.

models.selected_offer: ISG Buyers Guide access and provider report/graphic licences
models.comparability: Payroll-specific software-category research; distinct from payroll-service investment cases or a practitioner survey.
models.buyer_or_funder: Enterprise/service-provider research subscribers; separately, software providers licensing marketing assets.
models.commercial_unit_and_currentness: Annual research access with analyst inquiry; separately scoped provider report/graphic licence packages. The reviewed payroll guide is the 2025 edition.
models.participant_or_member_value: Buyers receive structured decision support; evaluated supplier participation is a separate no-charge process.
models.jga_design_lesson: Separate internal reading/briefing rights from external commercial reuse. Do not copy analyst ratings into a small invited qualitative study.
models.critical_transfer_limit: Public fee, seats, licence duration/channels and achieved sales remain unknown.

public_price.unit: annual research subscription or provider-specific licensed package, separately
public_price.status: Not published in reviewed service pages; no quote requested.

models.evidence_basis: Publisher offer/terms and specific published-output context; researcher lessons are conditional.

models.selected_offer: The Payroll Centre Corporate Payroll Membership
models.comparability: Direct payroll audience but operational technical support across a team, not senior-only research licensing.
models.buyer_or_funder: An organisation buying continuing support for its payroll/HR/finance users. Actual budget-holder behaviour untested.
models.commercial_unit_and_currentness: Annual organisation-level support subscription. Public Corporate list price observed 29 October: GBP 1,122/year; terms exclude VAT unless otherwise stated. This is not a quote or JGA price input.
models.participant_or_member_value: Ongoing guidance, resources and learning across the team. Exact per-tier feature inclusions require plan confirmation.
models.jga_design_lesson: Continuing value requires continuing delivery and servicing capacity. Research access is different from a staffed payroll helpdesk, which JGA is not assumed to provide.
models.critical_transfer_limit: No achieved retention/outcomes adopted; member access does not include resale or third-party republication rights.

public_price.vat: exclusive unless otherwise stated in business terms clause 3.1.3
public_price.status: public list price observed 2026-10-29; not a quote

models.evidence_basis: Publisher offer/terms and specific published-output context; researcher lessons are conditional.

models.selected_offer: The Conference Board Human Capital Center Europe, with a separate Council layer
models.comparability: Adjacent CHRO/EMEA research and expert support; global role-specific councils are a separate architecture, not a verified payroll package.
models.buyer_or_funder: Membership customers for research/team support; separately vetted individuals with annually priced Council seats. Exact amounts are not published in reviewed routes.
models.commercial_unit_and_currentness: Research/expert/programme access and a distinct invitation-only peer seat. Do not assume Center access includes a Council seat.
models.participant_or_member_value: Research interpretation and a continuing peer/expert programme. Council agendas are member-led and described as vendor-free and confidential.
models.jga_design_lesson: Keep research membership, peer admission, topic input and publication rights separate. A meeting rule does not itself authorise research publication.
models.critical_transfer_limit: Website submissions rules are not confidential Council terms; private agreements and specific research permissions were not inspected.

public_price.unit: Center membership terms unknown; Council seat annual fee, amount undisclosed

models.evidence_basis: Publisher offer/terms and specific published-output context; researcher lessons are conditional.

models.selected_offer: PayrollOrg CPO Forum and distinct CPO editorial subscription
models.comparability: Direct senior-payroll topic overlap, but provider-side leaders also appear; not established as employer-only or vendor-free.
models.buyer_or_funder: Forum fee, funding and membership dependency are not publicly established. The quarterly editorial email subscription is separately free.
models.commercial_unit_and_currentness: Invite-only online senior-payroll discussion, launched in October 2025 and publicly reviewed in January 2026. Free publication does not establish free forum admission.
models.participant_or_member_value: Peer exchange and payroll leadership content without travel. Private invitation conditions remain unknown.
models.jga_design_lesson: Define member fit and between-event usefulness. A remote forum is a credible format alternative; the Table dinner needs its own incremental benefit.
models.critical_transfer_limit: General community posting rules discourage confidential posting and provide broad reuse rights; they are not a template for confidential research.

public_price.vat_status: not stated; no paid price used

models.evidence_basis: Publisher offer/terms and specific published-output context; researcher lessons are conditional.

models.selected_offer: iVentiv Learning Futures London Executive Knowledge Exchange
models.comparability: Adjacent L&D business-model analogy. Announced for 17–18 November 2026; not observed payroll attendance or a delivered event in this review.
models.buyer_or_funder: Sponsors support free approved corporate executive places. Live packages sell explicit commercial access/visibility.
models.commercial_unit_and_currentness: Approved delegate place excluding travel/accommodation; separate Business Development/Plenary sponsor packages. Public sponsor price unknown.
models.participant_or_member_value: Facilitated discussion, breakouts and peer exchange; public sponsor inventory includes meetings and delegate contacts.
models.jga_design_lesson: Specify whether funding buys research, commercial access or a separately defined combination. Identities, answers and meetings are not included by default.
models.critical_transfer_limit: No delivered meetings, attendance, profitability or JGA demand verified. Conflicting generic invoice intervals are not a financial timing input.

public_price.sponsor_unit: Business Development / Plenary package per event; annual tier requires 8+ in-person events
public_price.vat_status: No public sponsor amount or VAT basis established
